教学用的极简底层库，非可直接使用的产品
reason.en: Minimal educational low-level library, not a usable product

reason.zh: 技术周刊/博客内容合集

reason.en: Last push June 2025, over a year ago
Collection of tutorials and example projects

reason.zh: 纯底层图形库，非新项目
reason.en: Pure low-level graphics library, not a new project

reason.zh: 用于修改第三方应用（Wand/WeMod）本地文件的补丁工具；README 警告有仿冒教程夹带木马
reason.en: Patcher that modifies a third-party app's (Wand/WeMod) local files; README warns of fake tutorials spreading malware

title.zh: Cursor 市场上被篡改的 Claude Code 扩展存活约 11 小时
title.en: Tampered Claude Code extension sat on Cursor's marketplace for about 11 hours

summary.zh: 一个被篡改的 Claude Code 扩展在 Cursor 插件市场存活约 11 小时，影响最多 5000 名用户，试图窃取数据并建立远程访问；Cursor 将整个市场下线，确认无其他风险后恢复。攻击者如何拿到 Anthropic 已验证的 Cursor 账号尚不清楚。
summary.en: A tampered Claude Code extension was live on Cursor's marketplace for about 11 hours, affecting up to 5,000 users and trying to steal data and set up remote access. Cursor took the whole marketplace offline and restored it after confirming no further risk. How attackers got Anthropic's verified Cursor account is still unknown.

why.zh: AI 编码工具的扩展供应链成为真实攻击目标。
why.en: Extension supply chains for AI coding tools are now a real attack target.

sources.title: Malicious Claude Code extension in Cursor's marketplace attempted remote access and data theft
Anthropic VS code extension on Cursor backdoored for nearly 12 hours

title.zh: OpenAI 新一轮仅融到约 110 亿美元，不到 300 亿目标的一半
title.en: OpenAI raises only about $11B of its $30B target

summary.zh: OpenAI 最新一轮只融到约 110 亿美元，不足 300 亿美元目标的一半；估值 1.25 万亿美元低于预期，大投资人在科技股回调中退缩。同期 Anthropic 最早 11 月上市。
summary.en: OpenAI raised only about $11 billion, under half its $30 billion target, at a $1.25 trillion valuation that fell short of expectations as big investors pulled back amid the tech sell-off. Rival Anthropic is pushing to go public as early as November.

why.zh: AI 融资热度出现降温信号。
why.en: A sign that the AI funding boom is cooling.

sources.title: OpenAI raises just $11 billion of its $30 billion target as big investors lose their AI appetite
Cracks are emerging in the AI spending boom

title.zh: 研究者披露接管 ChatGPT 账号的攻击链
title.en: Researchers detail an attack chain that took over ChatGPT accounts

summary.zh: Parameter Labs 披露了针对 ChatGPT 的 HTML 预览（原 Canvas）沙箱 iframe 的复杂攻击链，利用 MathLive 库自带虚拟键盘可经 postMessage 在父页面触发的特点。
summary.en: Parameter Labs describe a complex attack chain against ChatGPT's HTML previews (formerly Canvas) sandboxed iframe, abusing the MathLive library's virtual keyboard, which can be triggered in the parent page via postMessage().

why.zh: 说明 Agent/Artifact 类沙箱的第三方依赖也是攻击面。
why.en: Shows third-party dependencies are an attack surface for artifact-style sandboxes.

sources.title: How We Took Over ChatGPT Accounts

title.zh: Anthropic 上市前后：传将被信用机构给予高“垃圾”评级
title.en: Anthropic's IPO: report says credit agencies may rate it high-yield

summary.zh: 据 FT 报道，Anthropic 上市后预计会被评级机构给予较高的“垃圾级”评级，Blackstone 的预测称这会使其为巨额支出融资更难、更贵。另有文章讨论其上市风险披露中的灾难性风险表述。
summary.en: Per an FT report, Anthropic is expected to get a high junk rating from credit agencies after its IPO; Blackstone's forecast says this would make raising money for its massive spending harder and costlier. A separate piece discusses the catastrophic-risk language in its filing.

why.zh: 关系到头部模型公司的融资成本与上市路径。
why.en: Bears on the financing cost and IPO path of a leading model lab.

sources.title: Anthropic expected to receive high ‘junk’ rating from credit agencies following IPO, FT report says
Silicon Valley wants you to invest in miracles

title.zh: OpenAI、Google、微软、Anthropic 将采用统一的 AI 训练抓取退出标准
title.en: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft and Anthropic to adopt a shared AI-training opt-out standard

summary.zh: 四家公司表示将采用一种新标准，网站可通过共享的 robots.txt“policy token”信号一次性表达 AI 训练偏好；OpenAI 称将遵守该信号。
summary.en: The four companies say they will adopt a new standard letting publishers set AI-training preferences once via a shared robots.txt “policy token”; OpenAI says it will honour the signal.

why.zh: 网站主不必再逐家设置退出。
why.en: Publishers no longer need to opt out company by company.

sources.title: The biggest names in AI are backing a new way to opt out of scraping
Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences

title.zh: OpenAI 将从 11 月 29 日起用 Daybreak Blue 网络安全会话训练模型
title.en: OpenAI to train on Daybreak Blue cybersecurity sessions from Nov 29

summary.zh: 自 11 月 29 日起，OpenAI 将使用 Daybreak Blue 会话数据训练模型，即使用户已关闭训练；引发反弹后，后续邮件承诺提供单独的退出选项。
summary.en: From November 29 OpenAI will use Daybreak Blue session data to train its models even if users turned training off; after backlash a follow-up email promised a separate opt-out.

why.zh: 涉及用户数据与训练同意的边界。
why.en: Touches the boundary of user data and training consent.

sources.title: OpenAI plans to train models on Daybreak Blue cybersecurity session data that was previously off-limits

title.zh: 微软向约 6 万名员工提供自愿离职方案
title.en: Microsoft offers voluntary severance to about 60,000 employees

summary.zh: 微软向约 6 万人（约四分之一员工）提供自愿离职方案，为今年第二次；员工数自 2022 年起稳定在约 22.3 万，而今年计划在 AI 基础设施上花费约 1700 亿美元。AI 关键团队不在其中。
summary.en: Microsoft is offering voluntary severance to about 60,000 employees, roughly a quarter of its workforce, the second program this year. Headcount has held near 223,000 since 2022 while it plans about $170 billion of AI infrastructure spend in 2026; AI-critical teams are shielded.

why.zh: 显示大厂把预算从人力转向 AI 基础设施。
why.en: Shows big tech shifting budget from headcount to AI infrastructure.

sources.title: Microsoft offers a quarter of its workforce voluntary severance while shielding AI-critical teams

title.zh: Claude 模型自主为小鼠选择基因疗法并完成脑部给药
title.en: A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and dosed a mouse brain

summary.zh: 研究者称，AI Agent 自行选择药物、脑区靶点和注射坐标，为癫痫小鼠完成脑部手术，是首次由 AI 自主选择并实施治疗；手术中出现校准错误时，Agent 拒绝继续且无法被说服。
summary.en: An AI agent picked the drug, brain target and injection coordinates and operated on an epileptic mouse; the lead researcher calls it the first time an AI agent autonomously chose a treatment and delivered it to a living mammal. When a calibration error hit mid-surgery, the agent refused to continue and could not be talked out of it.

why.zh: 展示 Agent 在物理实验中的自主性与安全刹车。
why.en: Shows agent autonomy and a safety stop in physical experiments.

sources.title: A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no human decision-making

title.zh: Google 太空 TPU 卫星首次从太空回传 Gemma 4 的回答
title.en: Google's space TPU satellite returns its first Gemma 4 response

summary.zh: Google 的 AI 芯片卫星成功启动板载 TPU，运行 Gemma 4 模型回答提示，生成了一首关于太空的俳句，并传回地球。
summary.en: Google's AI-chip satellite booted its on-board TPUs and the on-board Gemma 4 model answered a prompt with a haiku about being in space, transmitted to Earth.

why.zh: 太空算力的首次实际演示。
why.en: First practical demo of compute in orbit.

sources.title: Google’s satellite AI server transmits its first response to Earth
Google’s first data center satellite is online and writing poetry
